content:
Matchweek 12 of the Liga MX Femenil season produced 31 goals across nine matches, capped by a pair of routs and a 2-2 draw in the Clásico Regio between Tigres UANL and Monterrey.

América delivered the weekend's biggest statement on Sunday, October 25, routing Atlético San Luis 7-0. Pachuca also ran riot the same day, beating Necaxa 5-0.

The Clásico Regio came on Monday, October 26, as Tigres and Monterrey split the points in a 2-2 draw. Guadalajara also won on Monday, edging Atlante 1-0, while Atlas beat Puebla 2-1.

The matchweek closed on Tuesday, October 27, with León beating Santos Laguna 2-1. Earlier results saw Tijuana and Pumas UNAM draw 1-1 on Saturday, October 24; Toluca beat Cruz Azul 2-1 and Juárez beat Querétaro 2-1 on Sunday, October 25.

Full Matchweek 12 results: Tijuana 1-1 Pumas UNAM; Cruz Azul 1-2 Toluca; Juárez 2-1 Querétaro; Atlético San Luis 0-7 América; Pachuca 5-0 Necaxa; Atlas 2-1 Puebla; Atlante 0-1 Guadalajara; Tigres UANL 2-2 Monterrey; Santos Laguna 1-2 León.

Sources: Vavel.
